objective: Step-5 silver-label freeze policy for reviewed sockpuppet candidate pairs, including current train-only silver strata in non-identifier-positive summary accounting.

split_strategy.unit: seller-connected-components over reviewed positive/negative pairs, with normalized seller-alias continuity also kept inside the same split; split assignment also balances review_label x review_stratum so validation/test are not made of shortcut-only examples

en_content_train_pool.description: If enough English identifier-primary negatives exist, train/valid/test must each contain at least one hard identifier negative.
English semantic-only negatives must cover train/valid/test when enough are available.
English semantic-structural negatives must cover train/valid/test when enough are available.
English identifier-plus-text positives must cover train/valid/test when enough are available.
English identifier-primary positives must cover train/valid/test when enough are available.
English text-clone positives must cover train/valid/test when enough are available.

zh_target_strict.description: If semantic_only positives exist in the Chinese strict pool, train must contain at least one.
If at least three semantic_only positives exist in the Chinese strict pool, valid must contain at least one.
If at least three semantic_only positives exist in the Chinese strict pool, test must contain at least one.

hard_rules: Only explicitly reviewed rows with a final review_label may enter the frozen silver-label table.
same_alias_identity_continuity rows may be frozen for audit but may not enter primary supervision splits.
positive_component_closure_audit rows may document transitive identity closure but may not enter primary supervision splits or final evaluation counts.
Soft same-alias continuity rows detected from reviewer-facing raw seller aliases must also be kept out of primary supervision splits.
Reviewed positive and negative rows must be split by seller-connected components to avoid seller leakage across train, valid, and test.
Reviewed supervision rows that share a normalized seller alias must also stay within one split, even when the direct pair evidence between those sellers is uncertain or absent.
Primary supervision split assignment must balance review_label x review_stratum, so validation and test contain hard positives and hard negatives instead of shortcut-only strata.
Every frozen row must retain review_stratum, review_status, review_label, reviewer_id, and review_notes fields.
If positive supervision rows exist, the non-identifier-supported positive share should stay at or above 0.3 when such rows are available.
Step-5 freeze must audit split-level label+stratum coverage and fail when configured semantic-only hard-coverage requirements are violated.
